criteria.description: Recognizable outline of India — broad northern Himalayan region, narrowing neck (Delhi/UP), broad Deccan plateau tapering to Kanyakumari point
criteria.visual_observations: India outline is highly recognizable with broad northern Himalayan region, narrow neck, and pointed southern peninsula.

criteria.description: Visible internal state/province boundaries dividing the map into distinct regions
criteria.visual_observations: State boundaries visible as colored regions with purple borders; some borders between adjacent states could be more distinct.
svg_fixes: Change stroke-width from 1.5 to 2.5 on all state border <path> elements to make boundaries more visible

criteria.description: At least 5 major cities or states labeled (e.g. Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Kerala, etc.)
criteria.visual_observations: 18 state labels and 10 city labels clearly visible with good placement and contrast against dark background.

criteria.description: Distinct, visually appealing color scheme — regions colored differently or gradient that makes the map visually attractive
criteria.visual_observations: Dark blue color scheme with 4 distinct region colors, red accent borders, and gradient background - visually appealing and cohesive.

criteria.description: Clear title India or Bharat visible at top of the map
criteria.visual_observations: Title India / Bharat clearly visible in red pill-shaped banner at top center with white bold text.
